title: Impractical and inconvenient
body: Reminders in Calendar seems like a bandaid to the Reminders app’s incoherence and impracticality. Location based reminders constantly go off even on off days. Once a reminder is made it’s settings are hard to get to and sometimes not all are shown. Sections and folders are thrown together and incoherent. Very basic Reminders based on day and time seem to work well. Keeping track of the Reminders upcoming date still seems to be the best way to keep track of them and understand the organization of the folder they are located in.

body:
Please, introduce subsections! And make smartfolder settings more liberal (so we can select wanted folders in a more detailed way)! Also connect scheduled notes to calander app, please! So we can see our deadlines in both apps. (Maybe even build up a link to shortcuts and notes idk, would be crazy.) (Oh and maybe add automations that when I tick off a reminder that it gets added to another folder. Ik it could get complicated fast so what about an „advanced view/editing“ setting.)

But this app actually rules. Use it. Really.
